subject.title: feat(workspace): lint and auto-fix code fences in markdown at write time

question: Should OpenClaw add Markdown code-fence hygiene to workspace file writes, and if so should it be default auto-fix, warn/doctor-only, opt-in, or plugin/workshop-owned?
rationale: This changes user-authored workspace files at write time and adds config/skip surface; the previous implementation attempts were closed unmerged after correctness concerns, so automation should not choose the product default.

options.title: Require warn or opt-in design first
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-approved design that avoids default silent mutation and proves parser safety before implementation.

options.title: Approve default auto-fix
options.body: Allow a future PR to mutate Markdown on write by default, with strong parser tests and upgrade/config documentation.

options.title: Reject core write-time mutation
options.body: Close or redirect the behavior toward manual docs linting, doctor lint, Skill Workshop guidance, or a plugin/workflow outside core writes.

recommendation.title: Require warn or opt-in design first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-approved design that avoids default silent mutation and proves parser safety before implementation.
